## The loop

`/triage <ticket>` → refine until agent-executable → `/workon <ticket>` → implementation PR → `/review <pr>` → human merges.

## Who does what

- **Humans own**: intent, architecture, acceptance, merging. The PR author is accountable for the change regardless of who typed it.
- **Agents own**: first drafts, tests, routine changes, review findings.
